verdict.rationale: Azure documents Cost Management APIs that let you query cost and usage data through multidimensional analysis, with custom filters and expressions over your Azure resources. That covers the queryable billing/cost API half of the story and implies resource-level granularity. The pack contains no evidence of scheduled cost exports; budget alerts are an adjacent feature and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented scheduled/recurring cost exports, explicit confirmation of per-resource granularity, independent or hands-on corroboration of the API.
